title: Wake up with the KSR Pregame Show, live before Kentucky vs. South Alabama - NewsBreak
text:
By Drew Franklin ,
21 hours ago
LEXINGTON, KENTUCKY - SEPTEMBER 5: Fans before kickoff before kickoff during the game between the Youngstown State Penguins and the Kentucky Wildcats at Kroger Field on September 5, 2026 in Lexington, Kentucky. (Photo by Crawford Ifland/Kentucky Sports Radio/On3) Kentucky Football is back home in Lexington today, hosting South Alabama in a Week 4 out-of-conference matchup. The Wildcats enter the game riding high, coming off the top-10 win at Texas A&M a week ago. Did they drink the rat poison all week? We’ll see when today’s game kicks off at noon.
But first, the KSR Pregame Show will preview the matchup and get fans ready for kickoff. The show begins at 8:30 a.m., live from the new Walk-On’s sports bar.
You can tune in live via WLAP.com or the free iHeartRadio app.
Even better, if YOU want to be heard, join the conversation by phone at (859) 280-2287 to ask a question, share your prediction, or check in from the tailgating scene.
To listen, turn your radio dial to 630 WLAP in Lexington or 840 WHAS in Louisville, or stream the show worldwide on the free iHeartRadio app or WLAP.com .
Go Cats.
Listen to the KSR Pregame Show Kentucky vs. South Alabama: How to Watch, Listen Kickoff : Saturday, 12:45 p.m. ET TV/Streaming : SEC Network (Dave Neal, Cole Cubelic, Tori Petry) Live stream : Fubo Local Radio : UK Sports Network (Tom Leach, Jeff Piecoro, Dick Gabriel) AM : 840 WHAS, 630 WLAP FM : 98.1 WBUL Online : iHeartRadio SiriusXM : 175 or 228 You can also follow along on the KSR LIVE BLOG, which will start a few hours before kickoff, and join the conversation on KSBoard .
